styles.name: Straight tuck carton
styles.note: The retail default. Ships flat, folds in seconds, takes fine print well.

styles.name: Crash-lock base carton
styles.note: Base pops open and locks in one movement. Worth it above a few thousand hand-filled units.

styles.name: Rigid lift-off box
styles.note: Wrapped grayboard, 1200-1500 micron. Heavy in the hand, ships assembled.

styles.name: Sliding drawer box
styles.note: Pull-out tray in a sleeve. A slower, more deliberate reveal.

styles.name: Magnetic closure box
styles.note: Hinged rigid lid with concealed magnets. Two smaller pairs on wide lids.

styles.name: Cylinder tube
styles.note: Wound tube with separate lid and base. Priced differently from flat cartons.

styles.name: Corrugated mailer
styles.note: E-flute. For anything traveling alone through a courier network.

materials.name: SBS folding boxboard
materials.note: Bleached, smooth both sides. The retail fragrance default.

materials.name: Kraft board
materials.note: Unbleached brown with visible fiber. Great for solids, muddies photographs.

materials.name: E-flute corrugated
materials.note: Fluted core, ~1.5mm. Roughly triples crush resistance.

materials.name: Rigid grayboard
materials.note: 1200-1500 micron, wrapped in printed paper. The luxury substrate.

materials.name: Wood / veneer
materials.note: Engraved or screen printed. Longer lead time, no photographic print.

finishes.name: Uncoated
finishes.note: No film. Fully recyclable, marks more easily, reads as craft.

finishes.name: Matte lamination
finishes.note: Scatters light, lifts color slightly, flattens contrast.

finishes.name: Gloss lamination
finishes.note: Deepens and saturates. Throws highlights under studio lights.

finishes.name: Soft-touch lamination
finishes.note: Velvet hand feel. Needs a keyline under any foil.

addons.name: Hot foil stamping
addons.note: Metallic. Needs an unlaminated keyline underneath.

addons.name: Spot UV
addons.note: Selective gloss over matte. Highlights a wordmark or rule.

addons.name: Emboss / deboss
addons.note: Tactile impression. Reads clearly in close-up video.

addons.name: Die-cut window
addons.note: Shows the bottle. Adds a film patch unless left open.

addons.name: Die-cut paper insert
addons.note: Immobilizes the bottle. Recyclable alternative to foam.

addons.name: Ribbon pull
addons.note: Slower reveal. Removes the box from curbside recycling.

swatches.name: Deep black
swatches.note: Print as a rich black build, not 100% K alone.

swatches.name: Clean white
swatches.note: Shows every mark. Specify a protective finish.

swatches.name: Natural kraft
swatches.note: The board's own color. No ink needed.

swatches.name: Gold
swatches.note: Foil rather than ink if you want real metallic.

swatches.name: Blush pink
swatches.note: A light tint. Needs tight press density tolerance.

swatches.name: Burgundy
swatches.note: Deep and stable across the run.

swatches.name: Navy
swatches.note: Reliable in CMYK, richer as a spot ink.

swatches.name: Sage
swatches.note: Mid-tone natural. Finish choice moves it most.

swatches.name: Terracotta
swatches.note: Warm earth tone. Reads best uncoated.

swatches.name: Deep purple
swatches.note: Often outside CMYK range. Spot ink recommended.
